title.narrative: HPN - Cluster 5: Boresha Jamii-FP/RMNCAH, WASH & Nutrition

description.narrative: (Kenya): .Using FY 2022 funds, USAID will support the Boresha Jamii activity to increase the use of quality county-led health services in Kisumu and Kakamega Counties through a service delivery systems approach. The activity will specifically strengthen county health systems by:.Building the capacity of county and sub-county health managers on leadership management, accountability and governance to enhance ownership and reduce donor dependency.Creating awareness within counties on domestic resource mobilization approaches and ring fencing of health budgets, so as to increase and secure health related budgets.Improving access to antenatal care and skilled birth attendance through advancing universal health coverage by increasing the number of health facilities enrolled in Linda Mama/Free Maternity Services rolled out by the National Health Insurance Fund among rural populationsImproving health information systems to provide quality and timely data in the District Health Information Software 2 package.Supporting the county in building strong integrated commodity supply systems at facility, sub-county and county levels.Improving access to safe point-of-use water treatmentIncreasing adoption of key hygiene behaviors as well as infection prevention infrastructure in health facilities in accordance with Ministry of Health (MoH) and USAID standards.Building capacity for the prevention and case management of diarrhea and pneumonia as well as efforts to improve voluntary family planning; antenatal care; emergency obstetric and newborn care; postnatal care for mothers and babies; nutrition and routine immunization.
